steps.text: Hui-chieh:
I don't know how much further I have to go.
I can hear the winter feathers chirp every now and then. Is that supposed to mean something? Does it mean that spring will be here soon?
It's still very cold here, but it shouldn't be much longer until it starts to get warmer.
It's been three weeks. We've finally found two more villages willing to trade with the Infected.
We've set up camp at an abandoned settlement a few kilometers away from them. There's plenty of fuel here to last us a while.
You can't imagine how awful tree bark tastes. I don't ever want to listen to the old man tell me how nutritious they are anymore.
December 7th
I am very well aware where this road is taking us.
Nonetheless, we have to get to the end of the road. Even if I don't make it, Yelena, Alina, and Eno and Sasha as well... I am sure they will make it.
But the road beneath our feet is just way too murky and hard to see.
Will they reject us? We can't bring their hopes up too much.

It's a bad thing to make a promise you cannot fulfill. The Ursus Empire's promise about bread and bed was nothing more than a ruse to cover up their atrocities and lies. And lies are what lead to tyranny.

Will they come to loathe us? It's very likely. If it wasn't for how hard life is in the Northern Plains, people here would probably report the Infected to the Patrol Unit the moment they spotted them.
This kind of animosity probably came from how worried they are about their own situation.
I'm not like Buldrokkas'tee. We certainly need to be on the lookout and avoid that, but I don't believe that's in their nature.
We can't hold it against them just because they want to look out for themselves. Definitely not.
Will they try to hurt us? I have no idea. And it's probably not something I can worry about too much...
No matter the case... I think most people are only like that because of the circumstances they are in.
If they had a teacher like Alina, a team like ours, or the chance to live in harmony with Infected... I'm sure things would improve.
Most of them were simply brainwashed by Ursus's twisted ideology. We can help them. Knowledge can change the way people think.

It's just... it's a really difficult thing to do. That's even though I believe... if you always hold fast to your beliefs in your actions, getting everyone to accept the truth should be one of the simplest things to accomplish.
【The words above were crossed out. Naturally, the letter was never mailed out.】

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Oh, good morning.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Wouldn't it be dangerous for you to head outside right now?

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: I talked to the soldiers, and they said the patrol unit all went to the village to the west. Did someone see you trading with them the other day?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's not impossible. Anyway, you should stay away from the west.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: I know. I'll go to the village to the east instead. I should still be able to barter for some things there.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Oh, you don't need to worry so much. Remember, we used to find ourselves in situations much more dangerous.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What are you trying to get this time?

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Some canned fruits and dried vegetables.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Are those things really worth heading outside for?

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Our fighters will get sick if things don't improve soon. It's about time you pick up a few things about taking care of yourself...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We're having trouble just getting enough food to feed ourselves. I really don't think we should go out of our way for....

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Now, Talulah, that's not right.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Uh huh, ahem—

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: 'It's precisely because there are times we don't get enough food on the table or even clothes to keep ourselves warm that things like songs, music, fruits, and flower, and our desire for all the things that delight our taste buds, our eyesight, and our sense of smell are so important.'

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: 'These are the things that remind us what we are fighting for: we're fighting so that everyone can lead a decent life.'

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Naturally, your health is part of all that. With just some vegetables and fruits, we can help a lot of people fight off their diseases.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Rebutting me with my own words... That's cheating.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Hey now... Cheating? That's quite a serious charge, isn't it? Here, say it after me: 'That's smart!'

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Okay, okay.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Do you need someone to go with you? A bodyguard, that is.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: That probably isn't a good idea. I may be Infected, but I am not that special. I wouldn't want anyone to find out about us just because of me. Besides, it isn't too hard for me to hide my infection. Easier than for some of our soldiers.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Okay, but you should still be careful. I don't think we can completely trust the villagers there... There are a lot of things that don't add up there.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Yep, okay. Oh, I'll try to get us some pears too. Or do you reckon the Yetis like apples more?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I think they are more of a fan of raspberries... but let's not worry about them. They know how to look for those themselves.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I've got a meeting now.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Okay, I'm leaving.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: —Alina!

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: What's up?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm thinking about putting together an Infected education group. Would you like to run it?

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Huh? Am I really the right person for that?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You have a much better reputation than me among the noncombatant Infected.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It'll be easier for me to introduce you to everyone.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: That's not what I mean...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Knowledge is a means of fighting itself, Alina. I insist.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: I'll leave the decision to you. I don't need to write up any speeches or anything, do I?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Oh, I can hear the applause already.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: ...Stop teasing me. Okay, I'll get going now.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: See you later. Don't stay out too late!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: That won't work. We need to hang them.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: The captain isn't around right now, but I know that's what he'd order us to do.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Remember, guerrilla fighters. We are not an army. At least not yet.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It gives a bad impression. When they first joined us, it was because they trusted us. They only started having doubts because of hunger. That's the only reason they made this mistake.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It only happened because we didn't keep our end of the bargain.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: What bargain? Feeding them what little food we have left?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We promised the Infected a place to stay.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Not everyone came here for a noble end. That's not realistic.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We could've earned even more of their trust if we had the machines exchanged for the provisions sooner.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: In any case, I cannot accept keeping them on the team.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Then let them go.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I won't tolerate any excessive violence. Also, give them enough rations for a week before you exile them.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Absolutely not! Not even our warriors get that kind of treatment!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We're not going to give in on this one. It has nothing to do with achievements or whatever. We simply can't abide by their behavior.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Fine. At least don't go overboard with the language. Don't chew them out too much.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: ...We can accept that.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Now that the patrols are trying to smoke us out to the west... we can't let them find the group of Infected there.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: That's all the more reason to put these bastards over...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Hm? Someone's knocking.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: *Pant*...

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Talulah!

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: It's the Patrol Unit! They're investigating the village that traded food with us!

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Should we get out of here? If we leave now, we'll be long gone by the time they found out about us!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Draw the patrol unit our way. I'll ambush them somewhere close by. We must let the patrol squad think we're behind it all, even if we have to leave our tracks behind for them to find.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Talulah! Think this through again! The Fourth Army's sentries are just ten kilometers away. Once they get word from the patrols about us, they will definitely come after us!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If the villages are pillaged because they gave us a helping hand... No, suppose they didn't. If they come in harm's way because of us, the Infected, we'll never find another village willing to trade with us.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Then let's take it upon ourselves to keep the news from spreading.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: That's exactly how word about this gets out!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Listen to me. If you try to put a lid on this by killing everyone there, the bodies will become evidence. If you then get rid of their bodies, then the deserted village will be evidence instead.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If you want to keep any bad news about us from spreading, then there's only one way to go about it: Don't let anything bad happen in the first place.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What we need to do now is to widen the path we have ahead of us, not just for ourselves, but also for the descendants of those who are following us down this path. Any questions?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: You have a point. Let's do that.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Right, what you said just now makes sense. Protect all non-combatants, and help them evacuate first.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We have a tough battle ahead of us. I'll be fighting alongside you, but neither FrostNova and Patriot are here with us; remember, one day, you may not even have me fighting next to you.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But as long as what you are fighting for is just and feasible, then we don't need anyone else by our side. You don't need anyone by your side.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Let's go.
